part.name: Rectangular filleted frame / bezel ring
part.description: Single solid rectangular ring with rounded corners and a stepped/landed profile. Geometry appears as a constant-perimeter frame with outer and inner radiused corners, multiple edge fillets (notably R10 outer rounds and R2 small edge blends), and two opposing broad planar faces. STEP B-rep: 1 solid, 50 faces (CYLINDER 24, TORUS 16, PLANE 10).
part.symmetry_note: Overall 2-fold symmetry about the mid-planes of the rectangle (left-right and top-bottom) and approximate symmetry through thickness except for the step/land distribution.

Section.name: Outer perimeter skin
features included: Outer corner radiused walls (large corner radius surfaces)
Section.function intent: Provide the external envelope for protection/handling and to transmit loads around the frame perimeter into mating structures.
Section.physical behavior: Acts as a closed ring beam: perimeter curvature and outer radii reduce stress concentration at corners; outer rounds improve durability and reduce snagging while distributing bending loads around the loop.
Section.geometry: Perimeter set of outer-facing surfaces: short-side outer planar flats, outer corner cylindrical patches (large radius), and outer edge rounds (R10 cylindrical bands) transitioning through toroidal corner blends.
Section.location: Outermost boundary of the part around the rectangular perimeter (visible silhouette in all orthographic views).

major_faces.name: Outer corner blend (lower-left)

major_faces.name: Outer corner wall (lower-left corner)

Section.name: Inner perimeter / seat interface
features included: Inner corner radiused walls (inner corner cylinders)
Inner corner transition blends (major corner blend set)
Section.function intent: Provide the locating interface/clear opening for a mating insert (panel, cover, gasket, or window) and define the inner boundary for fit and alignment.
Section.physical behavior: Constrains lateral positioning of a mating part via the inner boundary; rounded inner corners reduce local stress and avoid sharp contact edges; continuous ring helps maintain uniform stiffness and dimensional stability.
Section.geometry: Set of inner-facing surfaces: inner short-side planar flats plus inner corner cylindrical walls (smaller radius than outer), with intermediate toroidal blends (thin fillet/transition) near the inner corners.
Section.location: Along the inside edge of the frame (the large rectangular opening visible in the front/back views).

major_faces.name: Inner short-side flat (left inner end)
major_faces.description: Inner planar patch on one short side of the opening; forms a primary locating flat at the inner perimeter.

major_faces.name: Inner corner wall (upper-left inner)
major_faces.description: Inner corner cylindrical surface (R50) at one upper inner corner of the opening.

major_faces.name: Inner-to-step corner transition (upper-left)
major_faces.description: Toroidal transition (major R61, minor R2) at an upper inner corner between inner wall and adjacent land/step surfaces.

major_faces.name: Inner corner wall (upper-right inner)
major_faces.description: Inner corner cylindrical surface (R50) at the opposite upper inner corner of the opening.

major_faces.name: Inner short-side flat (right inner end)
major_faces.description: Inner planar patch on the opposite short side of the opening; primary locating flat at the inner perimeter.

major_faces.name: Inner corner wall (lower-right inner)
major_faces.description: Inner corner cylindrical surface (R50) at one lower inner corner of the opening.

major_faces.name: Inner-to-step corner transition (lower-right)
major_faces.description: Toroidal transition (major R61, minor R2) at a lower inner corner between inner wall and adjacent land/step surfaces.

major_faces.name: Inner corner wall (lower-left inner)
major_faces.description: Inner corner cylindrical surface (R50) at the opposite lower inner corner of the opening.

major_faces.name: Inner-to-step corner transition (lower-left)
major_faces.description: Toroidal transition (major R61, minor R2) at the other lower inner corner between inner wall and adjacent land/step surfaces.

major_faces.name: Inner-to-step corner transition (upper-right)
major_faces.description: Toroidal transition (major R61, minor R2) at the other upper inner corner between inner wall and adjacent land/step surfaces.

Section.name: Top/Bottom lands and step faces
Section.function intent: Provide seating lands/steps for mating surfaces (e.g., gasket compression land or panel support) and define thickness transitions.
Section.physical behavior: Flat lands provide stable contact/seat; step offsets create a shoulder that constrains axial positioning of a mating part; small-radius fillets reduce stress at thickness transitions.
Section.geometry: Two pairs of opposed planar land faces (a larger pair and a smaller pair) connected by small-radius cylindrical fillets along long edges.
Section.location: Around the long edges of the ring profile (seen as thin bands in top/bottom views; associated with the stepped profile).

major_faces.name: Secondary small land (bottom-side step plane)
major_faces.description: Smaller planar land face on one side of the step (one of the narrow seating planes).

major_faces.name: Primary large land (bottom-side plane)
major_faces.description: Large planar land face (one side), forming a broad seating/contact plane along the long direction.

major_faces.name: Secondary small land (top-side step plane)
major_faces.description: Smaller planar land face on the opposite side of the step (narrow seating plane opposite FACE 22).

major_faces.name: Primary large land (top-side plane)
major_faces.description: Large planar land face opposite FACE 9, forming the opposing broad seating/contact plane.

Section.name: Primary broad face (Side A)
features included: Broad planar ring face (outer side face of frame)
Section.function intent: Provide a broad planar interface for mounting/contact (e.g., against a housing, cover, or gasket surface) and define one major datum face of the frame.
Section.physical behavior: Acts as a primary datum/contact plane; transfers compressive loads uniformly into the ring; helps keep the frame flat and stable when clamped.
Section.geometry: Large planar annular face (a rectangle with rounded corners minus a similar inner opening), represented as a plane with an inner wire cutout.
Section.location: One of the two opposing broad faces visible in front/back views.

major_faces.name: Broad planar face (Side A)
major_faces.description: Largest planar annular face of the ring (plane with inner opening cutout; n_wires=2).

Section.name: Secondary broad face (Side B)
features included: Opposing planar ring face (other side face of frame)
Section.function intent: Provide the opposing planar interface, completing the frame thickness definition and offering a second mounting/contact side.
Section.physical behavior: Works with Side A to bound thickness and provide clamping surfaces; maintains parallelism/flatness of the ring faces during load.
Section.geometry: Opposing planar annular face parallel to Side A (plane with inner opening cutout).
Section.location: The other broad face visible in front/back views, opposite SEC4.

major_faces.name: Broad planar face (Side B)
major_faces.description: Opposing planar annular face of the ring (plane with inner opening cutout; n_wires=2).
